title: Vendor Performance Note: Late-Arrival Extension of the Free Hold on Ridgeline Special Order Services Items
content:
When the vendor delivered a Ridgeline Special Order Services item to the store late, the free hold of an order in a program whose deposit at order is 50 percent is extended by a late-arrival extension before any storage is charged.

**Clause.** The late-arrival extension depends on the calendar days by which the ready date is later than the promised ready date: more than twice the program's vendor delay threshold adds 14 days to the free hold; more than the threshold and not more than twice it adds 7 days; otherwise it adds nothing.

## Bands for the deposit programs

| Program | Threshold (days) | Free hold extended by 14 days | Extended by 7 days | Not extended |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Special Order Windows and Exterior Doors | 21 | more than 42 days late | 22 to 42 days late | 21 days late or less |
| Ridgeline Special Order Semi-Custom Cabinetry | 21 | more than 42 days late | 22 to 42 days late | 21 days late or less |
| Ridgeline Special Order Fabricated Countertops | 14 | more than 28 days late | 15 to 28 days late | 14 days late or less |

## Worked figures (hypothetical Windows and Exterior Doors order: promised ready date 13 April, program free hold 30 days)

| Ready date | Days late | Extension | Free hold |
|---|---|---|---|
| 4 May | 21 | none | 30 days |
| 5 May | 22 | 7 days | 37 days |
| 26 May | 43 | 14 days | 44 days |

The promised ready date is the date promised at order and never moves; the ready date is the date the item became ready at the store.
